## Core Products & Infrastructure

### QueueZero Clinical Runtime
- URL: https://kinbosoft.com/products/queuezero
- Overview: Distributed clinical queuing and automated outpatient department (OPD) orchestration platform designed for hospitals, specialty clinics, and regional diagnostic networks. Eliminates physical waiting queues and stabilizes doctor consultation cadence.

### Glowup Vision AI
- URL: https://kinbosoft.com/products
- Overview: Computer vision and dermatological intelligence pipeline delivering objective skin condition scoring, longitudinal progress tracking, and lifestyle correlation metrics.

### Relic Framework
- URL: https://kinbosoft.com/products
- Overview: Offline-first data synchronization and resilient edge runtime for field operations and mission-critical distributed environments.
